newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: New CEO for ABN-AMRO in Ireland.
newsitem.headline: New CEO for ABN-AMRO in Ireland.

text.p: ABN AMRO Bank. N.V. said on Tuesday that Anton B. Dikken has been appointed Chief Executive and Country Manager of the Bank's Irish operations.
Dikken succeeds Ed Merbis who has been appointed a member ABN Armo Deutschland (Holding) A.G. based in Frankfurt.
Dikken has held the position of CEO and Managing Director of the bank's Australian operations and has been a senior manager with the bank in Iran, Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia and Greece.
ABN AMRO's Irish operation includes a Dublin branch and ownership of Riada stockbrokers. The bank employs 200 people in Ireland and focuses on corporate financial services.
